remaining: Further object-language rigidity and well-ordering verdicts; no finitistic Con(ZFC) reduction is certified.

conditional_scope.components: Two actual pure-signature one-world Henkin component models with opposite quoted structural-CH witnesses are explicit hypotheses. Their existence is not established by this target. Component relational domains are preserved rather than replaced by external powersets.
conditional_scope.countermodel: Conditional on those components, their coalesced model fails the specified CH noncontingency sentence. The boxed-Barcan variant additionally assumes inhabited component domains at every type.
conditional_scope.maximalism: For a closed indicated type, the component hypotheses yield inconsistency of pure Maximalism together with that CH-noncontingency sentence, and likewise with its schema. This does not establish inconsistency of Maximalism alone.
conditional_scope.atomicity: The audit includes admitted singleton intensions in each one-world component and their coalescence, plus Atomicity and boxed Atomicity at every relational type under the stated model hypotheses. No external full-domain premise is substituted.
conditional_scope.projection: Projection/image characterizations and cylinder lifts are certified set-level lemmas. Their full object-language rigidity bridge is a separate obligation.

accepted_scope.ambient_construction: OppositeCHComponents constructs actual one-world pure-signature C components with inhabited domains and the original opposite structural-CH witnesses at type e. Its coalesced countermodel satisfies boxed Barcan at every type and fails the original CH-noncontingency sentence at e.
accepted_scope.ambient_metatheory: The external Flypitch forcing/completeness development is used in Lean ambient universe metatheory. Its ordinary-model endpoints have no explicit Con(ZFC) premise. No finitistic proof of a relative-consistency implication has been supplied; adding an unused Con(ZFC) premise would not supply one.
accepted_scope.conditional_transfer: FirstOrderTransfer assumes models or satisfiability of its explicitly defined witnessTheory, namely AxiomTheory.theory plus the translated pure sentence. The opposite-CH countermodel and Max applications there retain both such hypotheses. It does not by itself establish that these theories are satisfiable from Con(ZFC).
accepted_scope.maximalism: Every listed inconsistency conclusion includes Maximalism together with the specified CH-noncontingency instance or schema. None concludes that Maximalism alone is inconsistent.
accepted_scope.typing: The ambient component endpoints specialize to type e. Conditional FirstOrderTransfer is parameterized by sigma; its Max conclusions additionally require sigma.Closed.
accepted_scope.models: No external standardness, well-foundedness or transitivity of extracted arbitrary first-order membership models is claimed. Internal leastness, admitted subsets and actual internal graphs supply the relevant semantics.
accepted_scope.metalogic: Lean classical axioms used by the external construction are metatheoretic dependencies, not additional object-language principles of C.
